description: This file defines the IUnknown interface and related proxy/stub classes for remote procedure call (RPC) communication within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations for UnknownStub, UnknownStubType, UnknownProxy, and UnknownProxyType, which facilitate interface identification, method handling, and proxy management for RPC interfaces.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Base class for RPC stub handling, providing interface ID and method handling capabilities.

classes.name: UnknownStubType
classes.description: Template class extending UnknownStub to handle specific interface types and their methods.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing communication and reference counting for remote interfaces.

classes.name: UnknownProxyType
classes.description: Template class implementing interface proxies, enabling method invocation and interface querying.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of methods or handlers in the stub or proxy.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts incoming data to a specific interface pointer.

methods.name: InterfaceId
methods.description: Returns the interface ID associated with the stub or interface.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming RPC messages based on method index.

methods.name: Aquire
methods.description: Acquires a reference to the interface, managing remote references.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the proxy.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and potentially destroys the proxy.

methods.name: RemoteInterface
methods.description: Retrieves a remote interface pointer based on implementation ID.

methods.name: Channel
methods.description: Returns the IPC channel associated with the proxy.

methods.name: Interface
methods.description: Queries for a specific interface implementation.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes the proxy or stub operation, updating interface references.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Creates a message for invoking a method.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a message over the IPC channel.
